name: Arma 3
author: phillip@ehrke.online
description: Arma 3 Dedicated Server. Updates to the latest version via steamcmd every time it starts. Requires 5 contiguous UDP port allocations (primary + 4 additional, e.g. 2302-2306) -- Arma 3 uses the primary port through primary+3 for game traffic and VoN. The Steam account used does not need to own Arma 3, but must have Steam Guard disabled.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6 libcurl4
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

mkdir -p steamcmd
curl -sSL 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz' | tar zxf - -C steamcmd

STEAMCMD_ARGS=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "$STEAM_USER" "$STEAM_PASSWORD" +app_update 233780)
if [ -n "${STEAM_BRANCH:-}" ]; then
    STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(-beta "$STEAM_BRANCH")
fi
if [ -n "${STEAM_BRANCH_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
    STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(-betapassword "$STEAM_BRANCH_PASSWORD")
fi
STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(validate +quit)

./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${STEAMCMD_ARGS[@]}"

if [ -n "${STEAM_ADDITIONAL_DEPOT:-}" ]; then
    IFS='|' read -ra DEPOTS <<< "$STEAM_ADDITIONAL_DEPOT"
    for depot in "${DEPOTS[@]}"; do
        depot_id="${depot%%,*}"
        manifest_id="${depot#*,}"
        ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +login "$STEAM_USER" "$STEAM_PASSWORD" +download_depot 233780 "$depot_id" "$manifest_id" +quit
        depot_dir="steamcmd/linux32/steamapps/content/app_233780/depot_${depot_id}"
        if [ -d "$depot_dir" ]; then
            cp -a "$depot_dir"/. /mnt/server/
        fi
    done
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/arma3server_x64 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: arma3server_x64 missing after install -- steamcmd did not complete successfully."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/configs
CONFIG_PATH="/mnt/server/configs/${ARMA_CONFIG:-main.cfg}"
if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_PATH" ]; then
    cat > "$CONFIG_PATH" <<'EOF'
hostname = "Arma 3 Server";
password = "";
passwordAdmin = "";
maxPlayers = 64;
persistent = 1;
kickDuplicate = 1;
verifySignatures = 2;
allowedFilePatching = 1;
BattlEye = 1;
class Missions {};
EOF
    echo "Created default config at $CONFIG_PATH -- edit it over SFTP before going live (set passwordAdmin at minimum)."
fi

echo "Arma 3 dedicated server installed successfully."

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account username used by steamcmd to download Arma 3. Does not need to own the game, but must have Steam Guard disabled.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Password for the Steam account above.

variables.name: Steam Branch
variables.description: Steam branch used by steamcmd, e.g. public or creatordlc.

variables.name: Steam Branch Password
variables.description: Password for the Steam branch above, if required.

variables.name: Steam Additional Depot
variables.description: Pipe-separated list of additional depot,manifest pairs to download, e.g. depotid,manifestid|depotid,manifestid.

variables.name: Arma Binary
variables.description: Server binary to run. Use ./arma3server_x64 for the 64-bit binary.

variables.name: Arma Config
variables.description: Config file to load, relative to /arma3/configs.

variables.name: Arma Params
variables.description: Additional CLI parameters passed to the server binary.

variables.name: Arma Profile
variables.description: Profile name, stored in /arma3/configs/profiles.

variables.name: Arma World
variables.description: World to load on startup.

variables.name: Arma Limit FPS
variables.description: Maximum server FPS.

variables.name: Arma CDLC
variables.description: Semicolon-separated list of Creator DLC mod flags to load, e.g. csla;gm;vn. Requires Steam Branch to be set to creatordlc.

variables.name: Headless Clients
variables.description: Number of headless clients to launch alongside the server.

variables.name: Headless Client Profile
variables.description: Headless client profile name template. Supports the placeholders $profile, $i and $ii.

variables.name: Mods Local
variables.description: Whether the /arma3/mods folder should be loaded.

variables.name: Mods Preset
variables.description: Path or URL to an Arma 3 Launcher HTML preset file to install Workshop mods from.

variables.name: Skip Install
variables.description: Skip the steamcmd install/update step on startup.

variables.name: Validate Install
variables.description: Force steamcmd to checksum-verify every file on every boot, not just check for updates. Slow (can take many minutes) -- leave off for routine restarts, enable if you suspect corrupted files.

variables.name: Clear Keys
variables.description: Clear the /arma3/keys directory on every launch before mod keys are re-copied in.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Internal: mirrors the primary allocation port assigned by Wings. Arma 3 uses this port through port+3.
